lane: expected-DTI-optimal selection on a calibrated surface
hypothesis: Emission placement, not detection, is the binding constraint: on a calibrated probability surface the DTI-optimal dot set (greedy add under the exact kernel metric, then backward prune) beats fixed-spacing and maximal-coverage placement at matched mass.
mechanism: Adding a unit-mass dot raises DTI iff dT > alpha*T*dF/(alpha*F+beta*K); for a non-redundant dot that is kappa > alpha*DTI = 0.06 at DTI 0.30. The 3-px kernel makes adjacent picks redundant, so the greedy tracks the running credit field instead of thresholding pixels independently.
mimic_non_fault_process: Linear drainage/valley axes and range-front alluvial fan edges: they are 1-2 px wide, strike-continuous and carry the same LiDAR scarp and profile-curvature signature as a buried fault scarp, and they are absent from the USGS/INGENIOUS catalogue.

holdout_dti.calibration_fix: exact odds correction w = r*p/(r*p+1-p) for negative sub-sampling
holdout_dti.note: Pooled DTI over four label-blind eroded quadrants with whole catalogue components withheld and a 3-px feature buffer. Not an organizer score and not a projection of one.

leakage_canary.rule: any single feature with AUC > 0.90 is leakage until proven otherwise
leakage_canary.surface_note: Single-feature AUCs are computed on the held-out calibration quadrant of each fold.

correlation_vs_registry.literal_rule_note: The full scan fails the literal 70% 3-px overlap rule ONLY against the dense lattice comparator calib_r13lattice_00904 (overlap 0.9987, Spearman 0.0005, Jaccard 0.0084, reverse overlap 0.157). A lattice that covers the footprint at <=3 px spacing puts every sparse emission inside its halo, so the rule as written is unmeetable by any sparse candidate. Logged for the owner as IR-64-LATTICE-01; not waived here.

submission_note: DTI-optimal greedy+prune on isotonic-calibrated multiphysics surface
verdict_reason: holdout gate NOT MET; literal uniqueness NOT MET (dense-lattice comparator only; see literal_rule_note)
why_negative: On this holdout the DTI-optimal placement loses to fixed 2.8-px spacing at matched mass in all four folds, both before and after the exact negative-sub-sampling odds correction. The greedy concentrates dots on the highest-probability pixels, which cluster along the visible catalogue, while the withheld truth is spatially displaced from it; a spread-out covering recovers more distinct truth pixels per dot. Probability-optimal placement is only better when the surface is unbiased, and this one is not.
